testCase:
G-039: Alert and confirm dialogs
Goal: Print the ticket and then cancel the booking.
STEP 1: Navigate to /gopro/patterns/p39.html
STEP 2: Click the "Print ticket" button
STEP 3: Verify that 'Ticket sent to printer' is visible
STEP 4: Click the "Cancel booking" button
STEP 5: Verify that 'Booking cancelled, refund on its way' is visible

plan.title: G-039: Print ticket and cancel booking

steps.note: Request ticket printing; native alert handling is not available.
Verify the requested printing result, not merely that the button was clicked.
Request cancellation; native confirmation acceptance is not available.

args.text: Booking cancelled, refund on its way

steps.note: Verify cancellation and the refund status.

reasoning: The plan clicks both actions and checks the exact requested status messages. Coverage is partial because the catalog cannot explicitly acknowledge a native alert or accept a native confirmation dialog, which may block these actions from completing.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Acknowledge the native alert triggered by Print ticket.; Accept the native confirmation dialog triggered by Cancel booking.
gaps: Acknowledge the native alert triggered by Print ticket.
Accept the native confirmation dialog triggered by Cancel booking.
